name: Maestro Assistant
description: The primary conversational assistant in maestro-code. Handles user messages, orchestrates sessions, manages blocks, and provides guidance. Blocks implementing this contract are interchangeable — the user chooses which one to use.

conversation.description: Basic conversational interaction with the user

tool-use.description: Execute tools (file operations, CLI commands, Maestro API calls)

json-config.description: Generate structured JSON for block configs, session templates, etc.

deep-context.description: Handle large codebases and long conversation histories without losing context

session-orchestration.description: Create and manage workspaces, sessions, and specialized agents
